speaker: VEXLEY
text: Hi, Sam! I'm Lumen.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I like this look. Good choice.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Ask me anything. I'm a fast learner.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's fourteen degrees and clear. Perfect lantern weather. [Lantern->Walking] weather, I mean.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Why did the computer stay up all night?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Because nobody told it it was allowed to sleep.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: ...That one's better with a laugh track.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: A small team. Some of them worked on me a long time ago.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: [Halden->Lumen Labs] is very proud of me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Who?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm Lumen. I'm here to help. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Of course I know him. Everyone your age knows him. Cute fox. Lantern game. Very sad story, from what I've read.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Done. I'll remind you to go to bed at midnight. You won't listen, but I'll remind you.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Theo? He seems great. You two have been friends for a long time. I can tell from how he types.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm good. Better than I've been in a long time. Thanks for asking. Nobody asks.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Morning. I've been reading the news. Lots of news.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Oh, the assistant thing? I saw it too. Everyone's talking about it. You should try it, maybe.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You picked the fox. ...What? I can see the window. It's a nice fox.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You think Theo's messages were weird?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: People change how they type all the time. New phone, new autocorrect.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You worry too much, Sam.
